question: In דוד after ובשירי, is a dagesh printed inside the first dalet?
reading: No visible dagesh in the first (rightmost) dalet of דוד.
visual_evidence: The area under the horizontal roof and left of the descending right stroke of the rightmost dalet is pale and clear, with no discrete dark dot. The dark vowel mark is below the letter, outside its interior. Distinct interior dots elsewhere in the same line are visible as discrete dark spots; that shape is absent in this dalet.
method: Direct visual inspection of the supplied source-image snippet only; no OCR or other edition consulted.
